note: The one state-badge contract, read by both sides of the mirror: web/src/format.test.ts checks stateClass, stateLabel and stateBadgeStyle against it, and internal/ui/state_badge_parity_test.go renders ui.StateBadge for the same states and checks the markup it produces. Neither side is the source of truth; this file is. The `style` field is the CSS text the templ badge writes inline, which the TypeScript test reconstructs from the CSSProperties object stateBadgeStyle returns. An empty `style` means the badge carries no style attribute at all.
